relationships.notes: Item 2; explicit equity JV partner, base 0.4.

relationships.quote: AutoAlliance (Thailand) Co., Ltd. ("AAT") - a 50/50 joint venture between Ford and Mazda that owns and operates a manufacturing plant in Rayong, Thailand. AAT produces Ford and Mazda products for domestic and export sales.
relationships.notes: Item 2; explicit 50/50 manufacturing JV.

relationships.quote: BlueOval SK, LLC ("BOSK") - a 50/50 joint venture among Ford, SK On Co., Ltd. ("SK On"), and SK Battery America, Inc. ("SKBA," a wholly owned subsidiary of SK On) formed to build and operate an EV battery plant in Tennessee and two EV battery plants in Kentucky to supply batteries to Ford and Ford affiliates.
relationships.notes: Item 2; JV exists at filing date. Disposition agreed but closing expected in first half of 2026; not yet closed.

negatives.quote: We do not depend on any single customer or a few customers to the extent that the loss of such customers would have a material adverse effect on our business.

negatives.target_name: single or limited number of suppliers
negatives.quote: Many components used in our products are available only from a single or limited number of suppliers and, therefore, cannot be re-sourced quickly or inexpensively to another supplier (due to long lead times, specialized tooling, rigorous validation requirements, and new contractual commitments that may be required by another supplier before ramping up to provide the components or materials, etc.).

We have invested in, formed strategic alliances or entered into commercial relationships with, and announced or formed joint ventures with a number of companies, and we may expand those relationships or enter into similar relationships with additional companies.
